description: Freezes the first N rows and/or columns of a sheet so they stay visible while scrolling (typical: frozen_rows=1 pins the header). 0 unfreezes. At least one of frozen_rows / frozen_columns is required; the other stays as it is. You cannot freeze all rows or all columns of a sheet — at least one unfrozen row/column must remain.

frozen_columns.description: How many left columns to freeze (0 = unfreeze).

frozen_rows.description: How many top rows to freeze (0 = unfreeze).

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId (NOT the title) from get_spreadsheet sheets[].properties.sheetId; the first sheet of a new spreadsheet is 0.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.

name: set_frozen
title: Freeze rows and columns
